source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Check GPU VBIOS-Version via cmd: nvidia-smi --format=csv --query-gpu=vbios_version


1. All GPU VBIOS-Versions should be correct.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: 1. All GPU VBIOS-Versions should be correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; correct read-only field and full output, but missing stable GPU/asset correlation.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / IMPROVED; adds UUID/serial/BDF/model/slot mapping, version policy, error retention and no-flash boundary.

original_test_intent: Verify the VBIOS version reported by every required NVIDIA GPU matches the approved firmware policy for that exact GPU model, revision and physical asset.
original_method: Run the exact read-only VBIOS CSV query, correlate each value with UUID/serial/Bus-Id/model/slot, and compare against the model/revision-specific project version matrix without invoking any firmware writer.
manual_activity: Engineering supplies the expected VBIOS matrix and owns the verdict. The full per-GPU query and comparison are read-only and machine-executable.
required_inputs: Expected VBIOS version or allowed set by GPU model/revision
Installed driver/nvidia-smi version and support for the field
Policy for N/A, virtualization or board-sharing identifiers
safety_requirements: Use read-only nvidia-smi only; do not invoke nvflash, firmware images, protect changes, reset or write operations.
Correlate by stable identity rather than enumeration order.
Preserve N/A, malformed, missing and driver-error output.
Do not automatically attempt another tool or firmware action on mismatch.
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete stable GPU inventory and driver/tool version.
Execute the exact VBIOS query and retain raw output/return code.
Compare each mapped GPU against its approved version set and report Tool Result.
engineer_actions: Resolve unsupported fields or intentionally mixed revisions.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Directly applicable and read-only, but the version list needs UUID/serial/BDF context to prevent cross-device misassignment.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the source command and include stable identities in the same evidence set; never add a flash operation to this information check.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The vbios_version field, all-GPU scope and both 1-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Generate a per-asset UUID/serial/model/Bus-Id/VBIOS table and compare with a revision-aware approved firmware manifest.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: NVIDIA GPUs exposing VBIOS through the installed driver/NVML.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record driver, nvidia-smi/NVML, GPU model/revision, VBIOS, OS/kernel and virtualization mode.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA System Management Interface documentation for the deployed driver branch and project firmware manifest.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds stable asset and revision context without changing the query or performing a write.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; every required GPU remains covered.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A version acceptable for one board revision may be wrong for another even when the GPU product name matches.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve mixed VBIOS versions by board revision; the actual per-device version and governing manifest must be recorded without implying an update occurred.
expected_evidence: Driver/tool version and complete UUID/serial/model/BDF/slot inventory
Raw vbios_version CSV with stderr and exit code
Missing/N/A/error analysis and final GPU presence
Tool Result and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title, command and criterion consistently target VBIOS versions; missing expected values are project inputs, not contradictory facts.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only evidence can be collected safely; absent policy affects verdict readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the exact query but adds stable per-asset identity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with FULLY AUTOMATABLE and retains version-policy, error and no-flash safeguards.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates inventory collection, Tool Result and engineer verdict and makes revision-specific acceptance explicit.

review_improvement: Prevents a correct VBIOS value from being assigned to the wrong GPU or board revision and preserves the information-only boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: The requested versions are exposed through a read-only machine interface, so collection/comparison are fully automatable. Supplying the approved matrix does not create manual execution.

source_provenance.history: review_round_02_functionality.md exact-code entry and repository exact-code search

no_automatic_retry: On missing/mismatched VBIOS output, preserve evidence and escalate; never invoke a firmware writer or reset automatically.
